title: The existing intrinsic scalar restriction and its normalized comparison data
statement: Given a compatible ring map B→C_n into an inverse coefficient system, construct its unique section-normalized ordinary scalar restriction rhoOrdinary, its exact localization rho, and its normalized inverse-image, direct-image and open-extension comparisons rhoP, rhoR and rhoJ. This is the existing construction, with its section and transition normalization and proved isomorphism properties, factored into a support module. The compatibility of gamma with these comparisons remains the separate existing theorem gamma_scalarRestriction.
